chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:
“If a blind person prays facing other than the qiblah, then if it is within the prayer time, he should repeat it; and if the time has already passed, he does not repeat it.”

key_terms.فَلَا يُعِيدُ: then he does not repeat it
key_terms.فَلْيُعِدْ: then he should repeat the prayer
key_terms.لِغَيْرِ الْقِبْلَةِ: toward a direction other than the qiblah

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a blind person prays in the wrong direction of the qiblah?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a blind person who prays in a direction other than the qiblah. If the error is discovered while the prayer time remains, the prayer should be repeated; if the time has passed, no repetition is required.
